en_title: ‘I Meant It When I Said What I Said’ — Nicolas Cage is Actually Relieved That Spider-Noir Got Canceled
cn_title: 「我说那些话是认真的」——尼古拉斯·凯奇实际上对《暗影蜘蛛侠》被取消感到如释重负
opus_summary: 尼古拉斯·凯奇表示，《暗影蜘蛛侠》拍一季就很完美，他不想反复饰演同一个角色，因此得知剧集未获续订时感到宽慰。他还曾表示，自己拒绝签署允许剧集使用人工智能的同意书，并可能不再与亚马逊合作。

paragraphs.en: IGN got the chance to catch up with Nicolas Cage on the red carpet for his upcoming sports comedy flick Madden, where he opened up about his thoughts on Spider-Noir’s cancellation.
paragraphs.cn: IGN有机会在尼古拉斯·凯奇即将上映的体育喜剧电影《Madden》的红毯上与他聊了聊，他在现场坦言了自己对《暗影蜘蛛侠》被取消的看法。

paragraphs.en: Released on Prime Video earlier this year, Cage stars as Ben Reilly in this animated take on New York’s resident web-slinger. Available to watch in both black and white and color, the show received strong reviews on the outset, but officially got canned by the streamer in September after falling out of its top 10 shows — oddly, much to Cage’s relief.
paragraphs.cn: 这部以纽约本地的蛛网摆荡英雄为主角的动画剧集今年早些时候在Prime Video上线，凯奇在其中主演Ben Reilly。该剧提供黑白和彩色两个版本，开播时获得了很高的评价，但在跌出该流媒体平台剧集前十名后，于9月正式被取消——奇怪的是，这让凯奇大大松了一口气。

paragraphs.en: In a statement to Deadline, Cage said, “For me, one season is perfect, having said what I wanted to say with this dangerous, innovative, pop-art Spider-Man. Onwards, upwards, inwards.”
paragraphs.cn: 凯奇在给Deadline的一份声明中说：「对我来说，一季就很完美了，我已经借助这个危险、创新、波普艺术风格的蜘蛛侠表达了我想表达的东西。继续向前、向上、向内。」

paragraphs.en: He doubled down on this sentiment while chatting with IGN’s Jeffrey Vega in early November, who asked if the actor felt there was still more of Ben Reilly’s story left to tell.
paragraphs.cn: 11月初，凯奇与IGN的Jeffrey Vega交谈时再次强调了这一想法。Vega问他是否觉得Ben Reilly还有更多故事可讲。

paragraphs.en: “No,” Cage answered. “I meant it when I said what I said. It’s a perfect season. You never wanna get stuck repeating a character and wear out your welcome. Ben Riley is so idiosyncratic. I was doing something that was pretty high-risk, tightrope stuff — if you do that for season 2, season 3, you could really wear out your welcome.
paragraphs.cn: 「没有，」凯奇回答说，「我说那些话是认真的。这一季很完美。你绝不会想困在一个角色里反复演下去，直到观众看腻。Ben Riley太有个人特色了。我当时做的是一件风险相当高的事，就像走钢丝一样——如果你在第二季、第三季继续那么做，观众可能真的会看腻。

paragraphs.en: “So when they didn’t pick it up, I was like, 'Whew, thank you!' Because now I’m doing True Detective, and that’s only one season. It’s better that way, you know? I liked it when you would see Rock Hudson and Macmillan ? and it’s one season. I didn’t wanna keep repeating it. I don’t like repeating myself. It’s perfect, and I love that character. I love that season, and it will always be there and always be fresh.”
paragraphs.cn: 「所以当他们没有续订时，我心想，『呼，谢谢！』因为我现在正在拍《真探》，而且只有一季。这样更好，你知道吗？我喜欢那种能看到罗克·赫德森和Macmillan？而且只有一季的情况。我不想一直重复演下去。我不喜欢重复自己。这很完美，我喜欢那个角色。我喜欢那一季，它会一直在那里，永远保持新鲜感。」

paragraphs.en: Aside from not wanting to rehash his character’s story, Cage wouldn’t return to the Spider-Noir series anyway, as he famously parted ways with Amazon over its stance on AI. In a blistering statement , he revealed that he refused to sign a waiver to use artificial intelligence on the animated series and confirmed that he was unlikely to ever work with the company again.
paragraphs.cn: 除了不想重述自己角色的故事之外，凯奇无论如何也不会回归《暗影蜘蛛侠》系列，因为众所周知，他因Amazon对人工智能的立场而与该公司分道扬镳。在一份措辞严厉的声明中，他透露自己拒绝签署一份允许在这部动画剧集中使用人工智能的免责协议，并确认自己今后不太可能再与该公司合作。

paragraphs.en: "Amazon is a very AI-friendly company, to the tune of $50 billion invested in OpenAI. I'm not an AI-friendly actor," Cage said. "I'm not part of their club. I didn't sign the waiver to use AI on Spider-Noir. I'll probably not work with that studio again, but that's OK."
paragraphs.cn: 「Amazon是一家对人工智能非常友好的公司，向OpenAI投资了高达500亿美元。我不是一个对人工智能友好的演员，」凯奇说。「我不是他们那个圈子里的人。我没有签署在《暗影蜘蛛侠》中使用人工智能的免责协议。我可能不会再和那家制片公司合作了，但没关系。」

paragraphs.en: Cage has been open about his distaste for AI, saying at the 2025 Saturn Awards that "Robots cannot reflect the human condition for us. That is a dead end if an actor lets one AI robot manipulate his or her performance even a little bit, an inch will eventually become a mile and all integrity, purity, and truth of art will be replaced by financial interests only. We can’t let that happen."
paragraphs.cn: 凯奇一直公开表达自己对人工智能的厌恶，他在2025年土星奖颁奖典礼上说：「机器人无法为我们反映人类的处境。如果演员让一个人工智能机器人操纵自己的表演，哪怕只是一点点，那也是一条死路，一英寸最终会变成一英里，艺术的一切完整性、纯粹性和真实性都将被纯粹的经济利益取代。我们不能让这种事情发生。」

paragraphs.en: Cage is currently gearing up for the November 18 release of Madden , wherein he portrays the titular John Madden – a performance that has already been a source of viral debate among fans.
paragraphs.cn: 凯奇目前正在为《Madden》于11月18日上映做准备，他在片中饰演片名所指的John Madden——这一表演已经在粉丝间引发了广泛传播的讨论。
